name: Cloud to LAN bridge
description: Enable most Cloud features to still work even when LAN mode is enabled. This app will bridge all Cloud messages to the LAN, enabling control from Anycubic apps in LAN mode. Turn LAN mode on from this app's settings, then reboot the printer: the touchscreen's LAN toggle removes the printer from your Anycubic account

lan_mode.display: LAN mode (keeps the printer on your Anycubic account, reboot after changing)
